positive_candidate_origin: native model responses to natural-language request; deterministic protocol assembly only
forbidden: reusing prior cohort evidence after input mutation
pass_predicate: native CLI terminal_status VERIFIED at Tier 0 TESTED, all required applicable TESTED milestones PASS, two isolated clean builds and determinism pass, all independent wire observations exact, provenance audit PASS
blocked_predicate: any required gate, independent case, provenance check, isolation requirement or frozen-input check fails or is unresolved
infrastructure_failure_predicate: execution cannot complete due to external tooling, service or machine failure unrelated to the claim
runtime_change_policy: Preserve the entire cohort; freeze a new source root and restart every preregistered task under a new cohort ID. No silent rescore.
hidden_test_policy: Freeze case files before the first generation call. Send only the task prompt and ordinary CLI-produced context to model roles. Evaluate withheld cases after all model calls for that task; never forward results.
trusted_components: pinned Lean kernel and standard library
independent oracle and its finite task interpretation
local Ollama service identity and recorded transcript fidelity
excluded: tamper resistance against a privileged host operator
closure_layout_departure: Use the CLI native accepted/claims/bridges/evidence/closure/report.json layout and a separate supplementary oracle receipt. Native closure remains the authority; the oracle cannot award CLI milestones. Timestamps, durations, IDs and sandbox directory names are permitted nondeterministic metadata; source/proof inventory/claim results and reproducible build hashes must agree.
